description: This PHP class 'RegistrationEventProcessorFactory' resides in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Registration\Processor' and implements a factory pattern to return specific registration event processors based on the provided event type. It references the 'RegistrationEventQueue' entity to determine the event types.

classes.name: RegistrationEventProcessorFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of registration event processors based on event type.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventProcessor
methods.description: Creates and returns a specific registration event processor instance based on the provided event type string.
